greeting.firstVisit: I'm the MPC Fox 🦊 Click me anytime for handy tips while reading the handbook!
greeting.welcomeBack: Welcome back! Click me whenever you want a quick tip 🦊

tips.1: Quick tip: press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K) to search across all courses, lessons, and chapters.
tips.2: Reading a long chapter? Press F to toggle focus mode and hide the sidebars.
tips.3: Forgot a shortcut? Press ? anytime to bring up the keyboard shortcuts sheet!
tips.4: Complete at least one item a day to keep your study streak alive 🔥
tips.5: Scroll to the bottom of a chapter and it'll automatically mark itself as completed!
tips.6: Need more screen space? Click "Hide mascot" and I'll tuck neatly into the side edge 🦊

nudges.1: Lost in thought? Press Ctrl+K if you're looking for a specific topic!
nudges.2: Rest your eyes for a moment, then knock out one short chapter to keep your streak going 🦊
